project.title: Cross-Department Seasonal Promotions for Food and Garden Retail
project.objective: Design and roll out a coordinated seasonal promotion across restaurant, bakery, meat, and garden sections to increase sales and reduce waste.
deliverables: Standardised in-store display guidelines for all sections
Cross-selling scripts and talking points for sellers
Food waste and stock rotation checklist for promotion period
Sales and waste tracking sheet for the campaign
End-of-campaign performance and lessons learned report
constraints: Promotion must run within a 3-week seasonal window
No additional permanent staff may be hired
Displays must comply with food safety and labelling rules
Budget for materials and discounts is capped by store management
All sections must keep normal service levels during rollout
stakeholders: Meat and meat products specialised seller

risks.risk: Overstocking promotional items leading to increased food waste.
risks.mitigation: Use conservative forecasts, daily stock checks, and adjust orders mid-campaign.

risks.risk: Inconsistent execution of displays and scripts across sections.
risks.mitigation: Provide clear visual guidelines, short training huddles, and spot checks by restaurant manager.

risks.risk: Customer confusion about bundled offers across different sections.
risks.mitigation: Create simple signage, clear examples, and ensure all sellers can explain offers in one sentence.

risks.risk: Operational overload during peak hours impacting service quality.
risks.mitigation: Limit complex tasks to off-peak times and prioritise core service over optional display tweaks.

themes.why_relevant: Key to linking restaurant, bakery, meat, and garden offers into one coherent promotion.
Promotion must not increase waste; stock rotation and markdowns are critical.
Attractive, consistent displays drive customer attention and sales uplift.
Sellers need simple, aligned messages to explain bundles and upsell.
Sections must align on timing, stock, and daily routines without hurting service.

backlog.task: Define overall seasonal promotion theme, bundles, and calendar across all sections
definition_of_done: Theme and key offers agreed with all section leads
Promotion calendar drafted for full 3-week window

backlog.task: Create standard display layout for bakery and meat promotional stands

Restaurant manager signs off on layout

backlog.task: Draft cross-selling talking points for all sellers
definition_of_done: Short scripts for at least 5 common customer scenarios written
Scripts reviewed by restaurant manager
Final version uploaded to channel as guideline

backlog.task: Design restaurant special menu items that use bakery and meat products
definition_of_done: At least 3 menu items defined with ingredients list
Cost and margin checked with finance
Menu items aligned with available stock from bakery and meat sections

backlog.task: Prepare flower and garden corner promotion linked to restaurant and bakery theme
definition_of_done: Selection of plants and arrangements chosen
Display concept aligns with overall seasonal theme
Cross-promo signage referencing food offers drafted

backlog.task: Create food waste and stock rotation checklist for promotion period
definition_of_done: Checklist covers bakery, meat, and restaurant stock points
Daily checks and responsibilities defined
Checklist shared and acknowledged by all sellers

backlog.task: Set up simple sales and waste tracking sheet for campaign
definition_of_done: Sheet includes daily sales and waste per section
All roles can access and understand how to fill it
Test entries added for first day

backlog.task: Plan and document in-store mini-training for promotion launch
definition_of_done: Agenda with key topics (offers, scripts, displays) written
Time slots agreed with all sections
Attendance list template prepared

backlog.task: Detail bakery-specific upsell offers and sampling plan
backlog.owner_role: meat and meat products specialised seller
definition_of_done: List of bakery items to feature created
Sampling times and quantities estimated
Hygiene and handling steps documented

backlog.task: Detail meat section bundle offers and storage constraints
backlog.owner_role: meat and meat products specialised seller
definition_of_done: Bundles with prices and limits defined
Cold chain and display time limits listed
Any legal labelling requirements noted

backlog.task: Align on signage wording and mandatory legal information
definition_of_done: Short, clear wording for main signs drafted
Legal info for food and pricing checked with manager
Final text shared for printing

backlog.task: Compile end-of-campaign performance and lessons learned
definition_of_done: Sales and waste data collected from tracking sheet
Key successes and issues summarised
Improvement ideas listed for next promotion
